logline: 바다 괴물을 잡으러 나선 학자가, 괴물의 등에 올라섰다가 그 안으로 들어간다.
destination: 강철 배의 큰 창 — 바다 밑을 내다보는 자리
setting: 1867년 태평양과 대서양의 바다 밑, 강철 잠수함 내부
anchor: a bearded naturalist in a dark buttoned coat with round spectacles, brass-lit steel submarine interior
palette: deep ocean blue-green, brass and rivet gold, cold lamp white, black water

beats.visual: a bearded naturalist at a warship rail scanning black night sea, lanterns along the deck
beats.motion: lantern light rocks with the swell, spray bursts over the rail, his coat flaps

beats.visual: a huge dark shape sliding beneath a warship hull, phosphorescent wake spreading behind it
beats.motion: the shape rushes past, the hull lurches, glowing water streams off

beats.beat: 바다에 빠진 그가 강철 등판 위로 올라선다.
beats.visual: a soaked man kneeling on a curved steel surface rising from the sea, rivets under his hands
beats.motion: water pours off the steel plates, his hands slip, the surface tilts

beats.beat: 강철 문이 열리고 그는 안으로 내려간다.
beats.visual: an open hatch in a steel deck with a ladder into brass-lit interior, a man climbing down
beats.motion: the hatch swings up, his boots find the rungs, warm light rises through the opening

beats.beat: 선장이 그를 큰 창 앞으로 데려간다.
beats.visual: a tall captain and a naturalist standing before a huge round viewport onto lit ocean depths
beats.motion: fish stream past the glass, the captain's hand lifts, lamp reflections slide

beats.beat: 두 사람이 바다 밑 숲을 걸어 지나간다.
beats.visual: two figures in heavy diving suits walking through a forest of underwater plants, lamps at their belts
beats.motion: kelp bends around them, silt puffs up from their steps, light beams sweep

beats.visual: an enormous squid arm pressed flat across a round viewport, suckers on the glass, men recoiling
beats.motion: the arm slides across the glass, suckers grip and release, lamps swing wildly

beats.beat: 그 배는 어디로 향하고 있는 것일까?
beats.visual: a steel submarine silhouette descending into deep blue darkness, one lit porthole shrinking
beats.motion: the hull sinks downward, the porthole light dims, bubbles trail upward

withheld: 선장의 정체와 그가 바다로 사라지는 결말
